scope_limit: One controlled circular-track session, recurring riders; no new-rider, on-road safety or crash-prevention transfer claim.
calibration_note: Source computer-vision/Kalman trajectories, 25 Hz; select every 25th frame and exact +/-25-frame pairs. Parts of the same original video remain together. Track IDs may be ambiguous; all 28 riders recur across videos. Source preprocessing may use future smoothing, so predictions are retrospective trajectory dynamics and not certified online safety. Angular-neighbor interaction is a testable approximation; lateral separation and direction reversal are falsifiers.
timing_contract: Only current and past extracted speeds and current geometry/neighbor state. Future target speed is inaccessible to candidate replay.
exposure_notice: All packaged targets are exposed for future agents; future scoring is retrospective. Public source-aware corpus. Illustrative header/first-row values were inspected during the semantics audit; these do not constitute blind source acquisition. All delivered targets become exposed after confirmation.

uncertainty.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Verify native anchors and permitted information: Only current and past extracted speeds and current geometry/neighbor state. Future target speed is inaccessible to candidate replay.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check units, physical signs/limits, measurement preprocessing, identifiability and source-specific confounding. Source computer-vision/Kalman trajectories, 25 Hz; select every 25th frame and exact +/-25-frame pairs. Parts of the same original video remain together. Track IDs may be ambiguous; all 28 riders recur across videos. Source preprocessing may use future smoothing, so predictions are retrospective trajectory dynamics and not certified online safety. Angular-neighbor interaction is a testable approximation; lateral separation and direction reversal are falsifiers.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
